item.title: Local Roundup: Hazleton Area girls improve to 10-0 in WVC swimming
item.description: Hazleton Area improved to 10-0 in the Wyoming Valley Conference, retaining their grip on first place with one meet remaining as the Cougars defeated Wyoming Seminary 118-39 in a WVC girls swim meet.

item.title: Pittston Area wrestling posts decisive win in Battle of the Bridge
item.description: YATESVILLE — The Pittston Area wrestling team was simply too strong for rival Wyoming Area in Wednesday night’s Battle of the Bridge.

item.title: Jenkins Twp. Supervisors deny Forza Holdings rezoning, announce proposed data center ordinance
item.description: JENKINS TWP. — Supervisors at Wednesday’s meeting denied an application by Forza Holdings LLC to rezone a portion of mine-scarred land in the Inkerman section of the township following a hearing in January where members of the public voiced opposition to the proposal.

item.description: Wyoming Area School District sixth graders will move up to the Secondary Center starting next school year, according to Superintendent Jon William Pollard.

item.title: Editorial: Pashinski served NEPA with pride and made an honorable decision
item.description: Reporters who regularly covered state Rep. Eddie Day Pashinski knew one thing was as certain as sunrise: If given a chance at an event — regardless of whether he was a scheduled speaker or an impromptu visitor — he would grab a few moments of attention and offer his two cents on, well, almost anything.

item.title: Op-Ed: China’s stranglehold on critical minerals is now a national crisis
item.description: In the 1970s, when OPEC halted oil shipments to the United States, Congress established a “Strategic Petroleum Reserve.” It was an emergency measure to stockpile oil against a future crisis.
